owner_and_capability: Owner and workflow compositions stop building other owners' compositions (ADR 0059 point 6, decision B of #4004): the root builds those owners and passes them as dependencies. First slice: the grade transition workflow (workflows/gradetransition/compose) receives School Structure and Student Presence from the root (api.NewGradeTransitionOwners).
affected_tables: None: the same owners run the same statements; only the package that constructs them moves.
atomic_cutover: One PR: the workflow composition's Dependencies get Structure and Presence (required), the root builds them with the same constructors, the same database and the same no-op observers the composition used, and the two keys leave legacy.jsonl.
tests: modules/schoolstructure/internal/application/groups: the grade transition workflow suite (apply, revert, failure injection after each owner command) over the owners built by api.NewGradeTransitionOwners, assertions unchanged.
api: TestFullProductionRouterGolden and the grade transition route suites through NewGradeTransitionTestModule.
test ratchets and internal/architecture; scripts/backend-architecture.sh check and validate-ticket --all against the development merge base; scripts/test-changed.sh origin/development.

runtime_evidence.thresholds: The suites pass with unchanged assertion strength and the architecture check reports no new violation and no stale baseline entry.
